boundary_claims.no_live_data: This summary is generated from deterministic static definitions only and does not fetch, stream, refresh, or inspect live market data.
boundary_claims.not_investment_advice: This summary is a reviewer ledger only, not a forecast, recommendation, trading instruction, suitability view, or investment advice.

purpose: Give cold reviewers one compact ledger of strategy assumptions, risk boundaries, generated evidence paths, and explicit non-claims without reading live data or creating any advice surface.

strategy_assumptions.name: static_sample_scope
strategy_assumptions.summary: Results and labels describe deterministic checked-in sample artifacts only.
strategy_assumptions.review_boundary: Do not extend any result to live markets, another date window, another product, or an account.

strategy_assumptions.name: historical_signal_state
strategy_assumptions.summary: Entries, exits, exposure, and strategy states are historical model diagnostics.
strategy_assumptions.review_boundary: They are not buy, sell, hold, rebalance, sizing, or timing instructions.

strategy_assumptions.name: cost_and_friction_limits
strategy_assumptions.summary: Modeled fees are review inputs, while spreads, taxes, liquidity, financing, tracking difference, and market impact remain caveats.
strategy_assumptions.review_boundary: Do not treat simplified costs as a complete implementation model.

strategy_assumptions.name: same_window_benchmarking
strategy_assumptions.summary: Benchmark comparisons are same-period context for artifact review.
strategy_assumptions.review_boundary: They are not product rankings, forward expectations, or recommendations.

risk_boundaries.plain_language_note: The ledger summarizes documentation assumptions and static evidence paths only.
Historical metrics are sample diagnostics, not forecasts, guarantees, or loss limits.
Leveraged ETF-like samples require daily reset, path dependency, volatility drag, tracking, and severe drawdown caveats.
PASS, WARN, and FAIL labels describe artifact-review boundaries, not strategy quality or suitability.

not_claimed.reason: Static historical diagnostics do not predict future returns or risk.
The artifact has no broker, account, order, routing, fill, or execution workflow.
No portfolio, account, risk tolerance, tax, liquidity, or suitability context is used.
The ledger is a review aid and does not tell a reader what to buy, sell, hold, size, or trade.

reviewer_use: Open this after the static gallery when reviewing public maturity.
Use it to check whether assumptions and no-advice boundaries are visible before reading deeper artifacts.
Treat every path as generated static evidence, not as financial validation.
